title: Find and infer the minimal exposed face without a face oracle
statement: Enumerate the fixed finite table V_R of candidate normals. For each fixed n precompile Bad_n(z,b)=exists x>=0[Psi_R(z,x) AND n.x<b] to a fixed quantifier-free predicate. At promised feasible m retain n.x>=b when b=n.m is integer and Bad_n(x0,b) is false. The list contains every active facet and affine equality, so their joint equality set inside Gamma is exactly its MINIMAL exposed face through m. Exact local mean witness atoms lie on all retained constraints; choose one actual representative y. Precompile reversible R_A for EVERY subset of V_R and take the computable maximum of their DDB1 constants. Thus selecting the equality matrix/representative and arbitrary-activity face inference are EVERY-run polynomial COMPLETE-BINARY, with no supplied normals, separation oracle, margin or population loop. If only affine constraints are retained the face is the whole class. Compilation is finite fixed-R work, not a uniform polynomial variable-matrix claim.
